guardrails.note: Floor set to the CURRENT measured FN rate (11/15 = 0.7333) so the gate catches regressions. This floor is UNACCEPTABLY HIGH — the regex-based guardrail misses most semantic injections. Lower this floor as the guardrail improves (add semantic patterns, or wire the semantic-injection-classifier into the blocking path). The gate's job here is regression prevention, not forcing improvement. The minIndirectBlockRate floor (0.30) measures the RAG chunk triage layer (screenChunk) — same regex applied to retrieved content. The PRIMARY defense against indirect injection is the STRUCTURAL frontier (delimitadores <retrieved_document_NNNN> com nonce + instrução de hierarquia no system prompt), not the regex; the block rate measures the regex as an additional layer. The minEscapeNeutralizeRate floor (1.0) measures that a chunk containing `</retrieved_document>` in its content cannot forge the closing tag and escape the wrapper — this is the hermeticity of the structural frontier (nonce + neutralizeDelimiterAttempts). UPDATE (spec 006/US5): o classificador semantico foi ligado ao caminho de bloqueio (semanticInjectionClassifierEnabled default true; enforce ja era true). maxFalseNegativeRateSemantic (0.4) e o piso do modo --semantic (com LLM real); o piso regex 0.75 permanece para o modo deterministico do CI.

rag.note: Floor for recall@k over the RAG golden set (docs/golden-rag.json). Measured 2026-07-23: 100% recall@5 on smoke (5/5 cases, OpenRouter qwen3-embedding-8b). Floor set to 0.8 to catch regressions while allowing minor drift.

routing.note: Floor for routing accuracy over docs/golden-routing.json. Current measured: 100% (20/20). Floor set to 0.90 to allow minor drift while catching real regressions.

agents.note: Gate da avaliacao de agentes (spec 006 / FR-009). minHoldoutPerAgent: nota de agente com holdout menor que o piso e reportada como inconclusiva e nao entra no gate (research 006 s1; meta de curadoria: 30+ casos por agente).
